items.title: Hubert Laws — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yeah. It was a quartet: you, Chick, Eddie Gomez, and Airto. [INTERVIEWEE] And Airto, that’s right.

ctx.x: I remember recording with Claus Ogerman, but I don’t recall that. I do remember him writing these wonderful arrangements, but I just don’t recall.
Bill’s trio then was with Eddie Gomez and Marty Morrell.
That’s good to know. I didn’t know I played with Bill Evans.
